_readme: Edit this file to change RoadScan without touching code. After editing, run: git add config.json && git commit -m 'update config' && git push. The live site updates in ~1 min.

app.title: RoadScan
app.footer: RoadScan · on-device crack & pothole detection with geotagging

model._note: Swap in a new model by putting its .onnx in models/ and changing 'file'. inputSize must match what the model was exported at.

classes._note: crackSubtypeIds are the raw model classes treated as 'crack'; everything else is 'pothole'. For a different model, update these.

map._note: Where the map centres on load.

storage._note: maxReports = how many recent reports to keep in the browser. showSeeds = whether the 5 example reports appear.
